title: Narrative pattern → evaluator integration
description: F4 pattern detection feeding into F1 evaluator scoring (pattern-aware evaluation). Requires F4 to ship first.

title: Character-foreshadow cross-linking
description: Characters linked to foreshadowing events via graph relations. F2 and F6 ship independently; cross-linking is a natural follow-up.

title: HybridSearch pattern-based search
description: Using detected narrative patterns as search dimensions in HybridSearch. Requires F4 to ship first.

title: Writing session analytics dashboard
description: Session clustering visualization (timeline heatmap, session similarity matrix). Lower priority than feature exposure.

title: Chinese-novelist-specific features
description: Genre convention detection, tone analysis, classical Chinese style evaluation. Market research needed to validate.

title: Evaluator customization
description: User-configurable evaluator weights and custom evaluation dimensions. Requires F1 to ship first.
